cycles.name: fundamental_pulse
cycles.source: frequency analysis of the Officer-Williamson real-return series; band 2026-08-02; reads macrofield output (current USD), author 2026-09-27

cycles.name: business
cycles.source: frequency analysis; Capital Saturation ch. 6.4 and 9; reads macrofield output (current USD), author 2026-09-27

cycles.name: credit
cycles.source: author, 2026-09-27: anchored on each economy's credit crisis (low), 18 years; 20 years of data cannot identify an 18-year cycle

cycles.name: innovation
cycles.source: author, 2026-07-27; period the midpoint of the observed 40 to 54 year band

cycles.name: capital
cycles.source: author, 2026-09-27: historical resets per economy; low at the reset, peak 90 years later, next reset at 130 (the hegemonic period); orientation 2026-08-02; orientation inverted to +1 by the author, 2026-09-28; shape inverted to fall_rise by the author, 2026-09-28

economies.name: China

notes: estimated on 1996 to 2024 only: the trailing contiguous span of macrofield_output_growth; other years carry no phase
estimated on 1996 to 2024 only: the trailing contiguous span of macrofield_output_growth; other years carry no phase
the credit cycle is not estimated. It is anchored on a low in 2015 with a period of 18 years, supplied by the author for this economy.
the amplitude is normalised to one. The anchor gives the position in the cycle, not its size, and scaling it to the data would be inventing an amplitude.

the innovation cycle is not estimated. It is anchored on a low in 2032 with a period of 47 years, supplied by the author and applied identically to every economy: a 47-year cycle cannot be estimated from a national-accounts sample.
the amplitude is normalised to one. The anchor gives the position in the cycle, not its size, and scaling it to the data would be inventing an amplitude.

the capital cycle is not estimated. Year 0 is a historical reset, supplied by the author, in 1948. The reset is the peak; the cycle falls for 90 years to its low, saturation, in 2038, then rises to the next reset in 2078.
the amplitude is normalised to one. The anchor gives the position in the cycle, not its size, and scaling it to the data would be inventing an amplitude.
superposition and synchrony cover 1996 to 2024, the years every member has a position in
